question.value: What are the dust continuum and the far-infrared fine-structure and molecular line properties of the ISM in the z=7.54 quasar host J1342+0928?

evidence.quote: We use ALMA observations of the host galaxy of the quasar ULAS J1342+0928 at $z=7.54$ to study the dust continuum and far infrared lines emitted from its interstellar medium.
(program ID: 2017.1.00396.S, PI: Bañados)
eight different frequency setups reaching an effective bandwidth of 60 GHz, located between 93.5 GHz (band 3) and 412 GHz (band 8)
We have $>4\sigma$ detections of the $\text{[C\textsc{ii}]}_{158\,\mu\text{m}}$
$\text{\rm [O\textsc{iii}]}_{88\,\mu\mathrm{m}}$ and $\text{\rm [N\textsc{ii}]}_{122\,\mu\mathrm{m}}$ atomic fine structure lines
using between 41 and 46 antennas with 12 m diameter

evidence.quote: cleaning was performed inside a circle of 4$\ensuremath{''}$ diameter located at the phase center

we adopt the redshift and the line width values reported in (cite: venemans17c) and use them throughout.

analysis_steps.goal: Image cubes, continuum and moment-zero maps

method.value: tclean, uvcontsub, moment zero over 455 km/s centred at z=7.5413

evidence.quote: we imaged integrated emission line maps (also known as moment zero maps) over a velocity width of 455 km s$^{-1}$
we produced a cube with a channel width corresponding to 50 km s$^{-1}$ at the central frequency of the setup

validation.value: Adjacent 455 km/s channels imaged to check continuum subtraction

evidence.quote: in order to visually check that the continuum subtraction performed as expected

method.value: 2.6 arcsec diameter aperture with residual scaling; error sigma*sqrt(N)

evidence.quote: Error estimate of the measured flux density is calculated as $\sigma\sqrt{N}$
inside an aperture with a diameter of $2.6\ensuremath{''}$, corresponding to 13 kpc

validation.value: Aperture chosen where [CII] flux reaches a plateau

evidence.quote: the flux density reaches a plateau at $r=1.3\ensuremath{''}$

analysis_steps.goal: Fit dust SED and derive dust mass, L_IR, SFR

method.value: Optically thin modified black body with CMB correction, T_dust fixed at 47 K

evidence.quote: we correct for both the contrast and the CMB heating as prescribed by (cite: dacunha13)

key_parameters.value: kappa=2.64 m2/kg at 125 um; T_dust=47 K

evidence.quote: Fixing the dust temperature to 47 K, as is often assumed for quasar hosts in the literature (cite: beelen06)

assumptions.value: Optically thin dust; Kennicutt98 SFR relation with Chabrier IMF

evidence.quote: under the assumption that the dust optical depth is small at FIR wavelengths (optically thin regime)
A range of temperatures[^2] between 37 and 57 K yields $\beta=1.6-2.2$

method.value: Standard L and L' equations; 3 sigma upper limits; stack of four CO lines

evidence.quote: Line luminosities were derived using equations given in (cite: carilliwalter13) (cite: solomon97)

assumptions.value: Same FWHM as [CII] for all lines

evidence.quote: For other lines we assume that the full width at half maximum (FWHM) remains the same

method.value: PDR/XDR models, line ratios, Cloudy, CO SLED scaling to gas mass, H+ mass, metallicity calibration

evidence.quote: we make use of the PDR and XDR grid models developed by (cite: meijerink05; meijerink07)

findings_qualitative.value: [CII] arises predominantly in neutral medium; XDR ruled out

evidence.quote: which rules out XDR as the dominant regime in J1342+0928

claims.hypothesis: Does the host have FIR line deficits like local ULIRGs?
claims.experiment: Compared line-to-FIR ratios with local LIRGs
claims.finding: Line deficits agree with local ULIRGs

evidence.quote: Measurements obtained on our $z=7.5$ quasar host galaxy are consistent within the scatter with trends observed in the local LIRGs.
suggest densities of $\lesssim 5\times10^4$ cm$^{-3}$ and radiation field intensity of $\gtrsim 10^3\,G_0$

claims.experiment: Gas mass from several CO and [CII] proxies
claims.result: Ratios from ~30 to ~1200 depending on proxy

evidence.quote: Our observations favor a low gas-to-dust ratio of $<100$
we estimate that the metallicities are consistent with Solar values

why_this_method.value: Fixed 47 K because Rayleigh-Jeans data cannot constrain temperature

evidence.quote: the fitting parameters are degenerate and the dust SED shape and its temperature cannot be fully constrained

limitations_admitted.value: Dust mass uncertain by at least a factor of two due to opacity

evidence.quote: provides the dominant uncertainty on the dust mass estimate, which is at least a factor of two

limitations_admitted.value: Low S/N prevents line profile fitting

evidence.quote: Because of the low S/N of all lines except the $\text{[C\textsc{ii}]}_{158\,\mu\text{m}}$, we only analyze the integrated spectrum moment zero maps

referee_caveats_inferred: Dust temperature fixed, so beta and mass model-dependent
Fixed line width for all lines may bias weak line fluxes
Many results are limits; gas-mass conclusions depend on assumed CO SLEDs and alpha_CO
